text:
Hannah Li: hi all, day 2 and i'm mapping responsibilities. is there a single owners matrix (who owns buckets, routes, oncall) or is it scattered across repos?
Marco Diaz: welcome Hannah! we keep a lightweight owners matrix (Google Sheet) linked from the handbook, but the source-of-truth for service-level ownership is still infra/OWNERS.md in each repo. the sheet just summarizes contacts and escalation SLAs.
Hannah Li: ok where's the sheet link? the handbook search didn't return it.
Marco Diaz: it's in the onboarding checklist: Handbook -> "Team Contacts" -> Owners Matrix. ping me if you can't find it and i'll paste.
Rhea Singh: adding: practical tip — when you need something fast, open an INFRA ticket and include: service name, repo link, exact change, owner you tried, and manager approval. that speeds up triage.
Hannah Li: quick question about who to CC: if i request a short-lived SA key for a demo, who needs to be in the ticket besides my manager?
Marco Diaz: CC platform@ for infra, and the service OWNER from OWNERS.md. people-ops-bot will flag if extra approvals are needed. for demo keys <=4h oncall can approve; >24h needs infra manager signoff.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Any long-lived credential requests require manager + People Ops approval. Contractors require an extra People Ops review.
Hannah Li: what if the owner field is stale or points to an alias that doesn't exist?
Rhea Singh: open a PR to update OWNERS.md with the proposed contact. If it's blocking a deploy, file a ticket and tag #eng-oncall; oncall can set a temporary owner and escalate to Platform to avoid delays.
Hannah Li: who actually can approve emergency route quota increases for prod-impacting deploys?
Marco Diaz: oncall can approve timeboxed quota increases (typically <=4h) to get you past a deploy. Anything longer or recurring must be approved by the infra manager + FinOps if it affects cost. always include a rollback plan in the ticket.
Hannah Li: is there a standard escalation timeline? onboarding doc mentions "fast path" but no SLAs.
Rhea Singh: we operate informally but the playbook suggests: triage within 30m for blocked deploys, escalate to eng-oncall within 60m if unresolved, and involve managers at the 2h mark for customer-impacting issues.
Hannah Li: great. one last ask — who owns the Okta group sync for devs? i'm missing the `devs-core` group.
Marco Diaz: People Ops owns Okta groups. include people-ops@ in the ticket and CC your manager. Platform maintains the automation but PoPs approves membership changes.
Hannah Li: thanks everyone! saving this thread for new hires.
Marco Diaz: welcome aboard — DM me if you want the owners sheet link.
